name: zile-onomastice-ro
title: Zile onomastice și sărbători românești — Romanian name days and holidays
description: Machine-readable Romanian name days and holidays. Movable feasts are expressed as offsets from Orthodox Easter and computed, not hardcoded. Name-day attributions carry an explicit confidence value where Romanian sources disagree.

resources.name: nameday
resources.title: Name days
resources.description: One row per Romanian given name, with its name-day rule.

fields.name: rule
fields.description: 'MM-DD' fixed date, or 'easter±N' days from Orthodox Easter.

fields.name: movable
fields.description: True when the rule follows Easter.

fields.name: gender
fields.description: m = masculine, f = feminine, u = unspecified.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: How well-attested the attribution is. 'established' = direct saint's feast; 'convention' = attached to a root name by Romanian practice; 'approximate' = the real feast does not fit the date grammar; 'single-source' = found in only one source.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Explanation of the caveat. Always present when confidence is not 'established'.

resources.name: holidays
resources.title: Holidays and occasions
resources.description: Holidays, major name-day feasts, and undated life events.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: 'holiday', 'nameday' (a major feast carrying several names), or 'life-event' (birthday, wedding, condolences — not tied to a date).

fields.name: rule
fields.description: 'MM-DD' or 'easter±N'. Empty only for life events.
